key_catalyst: Alphabet and Tesla earnings disappointments on AI capex and margins coupled with Brent crude surging near $100 on Red Sea attacks
reasoning: The after-hours earnings disappointments from Alphabet and Tesla regarding AI capex ROI and margin compression, combined with an escalating geopolitical oil shock pushing Brent near $100 and 10-year yields to 4.7%, create material overnight gap-down risk.
